purpose: Submit the cart form with the 'Apply coupon' button to try to apply a discount code to the session cart.

bodyFields.name: discountcouponcode
bodyFields.description: The coupon text. Empty, whitespace-only, unknown, 300-char and HTML-special values all give the same failure.

bodyFields.name: applydiscountcouponcode
bodyFields.description: Submit-button name/value that selects the action. Without it the POST just re-renders the cart with no alert.

bodyFields.name: itemquantity{cartItemId}
bodyFields.description: The browser always sends one per cart line (e.g. itemquantity169023). Not needed for the failure result.

bodyFields.name: giftcardcouponcode
bodyFields.description: Sent empty by the browser form; ignored when applydiscountcouponcode is the button.

bodyFields.name: CountryId
bodyFields.description: Estimate-shipping field the browser sends along.

bodyFields.name: StateProvinceId
bodyFields.description: Estimate-shipping field the browser sends along.

bodyFields.name: ZipPostalCode
bodyFields.description: Estimate-shipping field the browser sends along.

success.bodySignal: NOT OBSERVED: no valid discount code was found, so the applied state is unknown

failure.bodySignal:
HTML cart page with
The coupon code you entered couldn't be applied to your order; totals unchanged. Same text for empty, unknown, spaces-only, long and special-character codes. With an empty cart the page shows the empty-cart warning instead and no coupon alert.

bodyFields.name: applygiftcardcouponcode
bodyFields.description: Submit-button name/value that selects the action.

bodyFields.name: itemquantity{cartItemId}
